content.title: 'Bachelorette' Season 22 (2026): Premiere Date, Cast & More
content.text: Key Points'The Bachelorette' Season 22 premieres March 22, 2026, with Taylor Frankie Paul as lead.Taylor Frankie Paul is a viral TikTok star and 'Secret Lives of Mormon Wives' cast member.Potential suitors range from 27 to 44; filming began October 26 in Los Angeles.Bachelor Nation is going a bit rogue for its first entry of 2026—instead of The Bachelor, which typically has a winter/spring premiere, the franchise is launching the 22nd season of The Bachelorette. It has also chosen to cast a lead from outside the franchise family in Secret Lives of Mormon Wives star Taylor Frankie Paul. Here’s everything we know so far about The Bachelorette’s new season, premiering in 2026.Related: ‘The Secret Lives of Mormon Wives’ Star Taylor Frankie Paul’s Relationship History When Does The Bachelorette Season 22 Premiere? The franchise moves to a new night this spring, premiering its 22nd season on Sunday, March 22. 🌹 SIGN UP for our The Bachelor newsletter to stay up to date on the latest Bachelor Nation news, exclusive interviews, episode recaps & more 🌹 Who is the new Bachelorette? ‘Bachelorette’ Taylor Frankie PaulABC The new franchise lead is Taylor Frankie Paul, a cast member from the Hulu reality series The Secret Lives of Mormon Wives. Her ABC bio reads, “After igniting ‘MomTok’ and going viral for pulling back the curtain on Salt Lake’s soft-swinging scene in Hulu’s Emmy Award-nominated series The Secret Lives of Mormon Wives, the 31-year-old Utah native is ready to trade headline-making heartbreak for hometown dates as she begins making her mark on Bachelor Nation. “Paul is the breakout star of The Secret Lives of Mormon Wives, captivating millions with her raw, unapologetic storytelling. Off-screen, she’s a TikTok powerhouse whose comedic, heartwarming and bitingly honest content has earned her a massive following. As a single mother of three, Paul shares the highs and lows of her life with unfiltered candor. With humor, resilience and a fearless openness, she inspires others to embrace life’s chaos and own their story.” Related: Jesse Palmer Announces ‘Bachelor Nation’ Cruise: ‘The Ultimate Group Date’ Who are the cast members for The Bachelorette Season 22? ABC has officially released the cast of men who will appear on the upcoming season. The ages skew a tad older than normal, which makes sense because Taylor is 31; that’s a little bit older than most leads of this show. The possible suitors range in age from 28 to 43. The list ABC teased is as follows: Aaron, 32, Vineyard, UtahBrad, 29, Newport Beach, California/Nashville, TennesseeBrandon, 28, Spearfish, South DakotaCasey, 30, Nashville, TennesseeChristopher, 35, Vacaville, CaliforniaClayton, 36, Nashville, TennesseeConrad, 32, Santa Monica, CaliforniaDoug, 28, San Diego, CaliforniaJohnnie, 30, Massapequa, New YorkJosh, 28, Provo, UtahKevin, 32, Miami, FloridaLew, 32, Salt Lake City, UtahMalik, 30, Brooklyn, New YorkMarcus, 28, Elmont, New YorkMatt, 43, Carmel, IndianaMichael Baba, 36, San Diego, CaliforniaMike, 36, Lavallette, New JerseyRichard, 35, Charleston, South CarolinaRod, 35, Austin, TexasRonn, 28, San Francisco, CaliforniaShane, 28, Atlanta, GeorgiaTrenten, 35, Capistrano, California Related: ‘Secret Lives of Mormon Wives’ Star Announces Decidedly Un-Mormon, ‘Dirty’ New Project When did the new season of The Bachelorette start filming? According to Reality Steve, filming for season 22 of The Bachelorette started on Sunday, October 26, in Los Angeles at the Bachelor Nation mansion. When is the finale of The Bachelorette Season 22? There is no exact date announced yet for the finale, but the winter/spring edition of the franchise typically airs about two calendar months, so one might think the finale will be Sunday, May 24. However, that happens to be the Sunday of Memorial Day weekend, so that is probably not the finale date. Instead, we would expect The Bachelorette to wrap up on Sunday, May 17, 2026. The Golden Bachelor season 2 ended back in November 2025. The 22nd season of The Bachelorette is premiering March 22, 2026, with Secret Lives of Mormon Wives star Taylor Frankie Paul as the lead.
